suite: Security scans QA NXT runs itself
objective: A narrowed run reports partial coverage and does not pass the gate on that basis
input: A scan narrowed to one of the implied checks
expected: The full implied set still travels as the configured set, so the coverage rule fails and the gate asks for review. Narrowing a run must cost coverage; if it narrowed the denominator too, running one check would report as complete
detail: configured 4, asked for 1; gate review: 1 of 4 configured check(s) executed (25%; the policy requires 80%).
